description_en: Queries a list of cache refresh tasks
description_zh: 获取缓存刷新任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-isp-flush-cache-tasks --lang example-string --page-number 1 --page-size 1 --isp example-string --domain-name example-string --order-by example-string --direction example-string --instance-id example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeIspFlushCacheTasks

parameters.help_en: The language of the response. Valid values: zh: Chinese. en: English
parameters.help_zh: 返回信息的语言，zh 为中文，en 为英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from 1
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的页码，从 1 开始
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The Internet service provider (ISP) used to filter results. Valid values: TELECOM
parameters.help_zh: 按运营商筛选，当前支持 TELECOM（电信）
parameters.name: isp

parameters.help_en: The domain name used to filter the cache refresh tasks
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The field used to sort the task list. Valid values: CREATE_DATE
parameters.help_zh: 任务列表排序字段，目前支持 CREATE_DATE（创建时间）
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The sort order. Valid values: ASC: Ascending order. DESC: Descending order
parameters.help_zh: 排序方向：ASC 为升序，DESC 为降序
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cache refresh instance used to filter tasks
parameters.help_zh: 按缓存刷新实例 ID 筛选
parameters.name: instance_id

IspFlushCacheTasks.description_en: The list of cache refresh tasks that meet the query conditions
IspFlushCacheTasks.description_zh: 符合条件的缓存刷新任务列表

items.description_en: The information about a single cache refresh task
items.description_zh: 单个缓存刷新任务的信息

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the task was created. The time is displayed in UTC in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format
CreateTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间，使用 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp of the time when the task was created, in milliseconds
CreateTimestamp.description_zh: 任务创建时间的毫秒时间戳

DomainName.description_en: The domain name refreshed by the task

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the cache refresh instance to which the task belongs
InstanceId.description_zh: 任务所属的缓存刷新实例 ID

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the cache refresh instance to which the task belongs
InstanceName.description_zh: 任务所属的缓存刷新实例名称

Isp.description_en: The ISP refreshed by the task. A value of TELECOM indicates China Telecom
Isp.description_zh: 任务刷新的运营商，TELECOM 表示电信

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the cache refresh task

TaskStatus.description_en: The status of the task. Valid values: EXECUTING: The task is being executed. SUCCESSFUL: The task succeeded. FAILED: The task failed
TaskStatus.description_zh: 任务状态：EXECUTING 为执行中，SUCCESSFUL 为成功，FAILED 为失败

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 当前返回结果的每页记录数

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

TotalItems.description_en: The total number of entries returned

TotalPages.description_en: The total number of pages returned
